citation.authors: Kyei A, Bergfeld WF, Piliang M, Summers P

cited_by.title: CCCA: scarring hair loss at the crown

record.population: 326 African American women at churches and a health fair, Cleveland
record.finding: 28% scored as clinically evident central hair loss. Traction-associated hairstyles (braids and weaves) were associated with central scarring hair loss (P=.02), as were bacterial scalp infections and type 2 diabetes.
record.note: Survey at two churches and a health fair: not a population prevalence.
